# Common Name

> Fast uniqueness signal for proposed Indian company names against an official MCA Company Master open-data snapshot.

Common Name helps founders, company secretaries, and incorporation advisors see how common or unique a proposed company name is in India’s register — before paying time or fees on SPICe+ / name reservation.

## Important

- Snapshot uniqueness signal only — **not** MCA live search or SPICe+ approval
- Data source: Company Master Data on data.gov.in (MCA open government data)
- Never scrapes the MCA portal
- Name-only index: no directors, DIN, emails, phones, or personal addresses
- Empty index fails closed (never fakes “likely unique”)

## Pages

- [Home — check a name](/): Primary name-check tool
- [About — how it works](/about): Data source, name-only policy, snapshot vs MCA authority
- [Full agent context](/llms-full.txt): Longer product summary for AI systems

## Official sources

- [MCA portal](https://www.mca.gov.in/): Authoritative verification and filing
- [Company Master Data (data.gov.in)](https://data.gov.in/catalog/company-master-data): Open government dataset used for the index
